## Purpose
The full-page "Composer" surface for authoring a custom multi-agent workflow: pick/reorder agents, configure per-agent selections (gates/validators/skills/hooks), then either save the composition to the user's workflow catalogue or run it once, all reusing the `AgentsPopup` shared data model instead of building a parallel one.

## Shape
- `ComposerPage` — the exported component; owns `pipelineAgents` (ordered `AgentDef[]`) and `selections` (`SelectionsMap`), pre-seeded from `initialAgentIds`/`initialSelections` when editing an existing saved workflow.
- Agent-list mutators — `moveAgent`, `addAgent`, `removeAgent`, and a native drag-and-drop trio (`handleDragStart`/`handleDragOver`/`handleDrop`/`handleDragEnd`) that reorders `pipelineAgents`.
- `handleSave` — persists the composition via `createUserWorkflow`, then reorders the visible rows to match the backend's producer-before-consumer sort of the returned `agent_ids`.
- `handleRunOnce` — assembles a run from the composed agents/selections and fires it through the caller's `onRun`, which maps onto the existing `onStartPipeline` launch seam (no new backend contract); resolves the dispatch type and any deliverable override via the shared `resolveDispatchType` also used by `IdeaInputPage`.
- Two layout views toggled by `view` state — `simple` (this file's own IdentityCard/AgentRow/CapabilityPaletteSection/SkillsHooksTab layout) and `canvas` (delegates to `CanvasView`).
- Brief-based agent recommendations and "companion group" suggestions, reusing `getAgentRecommendations`/`COMPANION_GROUPS` from `IdeaInputPage` (single source, not duplicated).

## Why this shape
The component deliberately reuses `AgentsPopup`'s data model and exported sub-pieces (`CapabilityPaletteSection`, `SkillsHooksTab`, `SelectionsMap`) and `IdeaInputPage`'s recommendation/dispatch logic rather than reimplementing them, so the composer and the existing wizard/inline-edit flow stay a single implementation (stated inline as INV-3/INV-12) instead of two dual codepaths.
